exposure: maternal plasma per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) concentrations
cohort: The study included 1189 mother-child dyads from the prospective Boston Birth Cohort.
finding: Early life exposure to individual PFAS and their mixture was associated with a higher risk of childhood overweight or obesity, with stronger associations observed in older child age groups and in children of non-OWO mothers, and synergistic effects with maternal pre-pregnancy OWO becoming evident in adolescence.
